agents.changed: This Agent changed. Reload before saving.
agents.probeUnsupported: Environment inspection requires an updated Runner connection.
agents.runtimeSetupFailed: Unable to prepare the Agent runtime. Check the Runner installation policy, Node/npm, network and version settings. Configuration isolation requires the default managed working directory.
agents.modelRequired: This Agent has no usable model. Choose an enabled CLI or API model for it on the Agent page (configure one on the models page first); it never runs a host's own CLI configuration without one.
agents.unknownField: The request contains a field that cannot be changed here; reload the page and try again.
agents.roleNotFound: The selected platform role no longer exists; choose another role.
agents.modelDisabled: The selected model is disabled; enable it on the models page or choose another model.
agents.modelNotListed: Model "{model}" is not in this model configuration's list; choose a listed model or add it on the models page.
agents.nameRequired: Enter a name for the agent.
agents.nameTooLong: The agent name can be at most 128 characters.
agents.roleTooLong: The role description can be at most 256 characters.
agents.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most 4 KB.
agents.instructionsTooLong: The instructions can be at most 32 KB.
agents.directoryInvalid: The working directory path is too long (at most 4,096 bytes).
agents.modelIdInvalid: The model ID is invalid: at most 256 characters, not starting with "-" and without control characters.
agents.permissionInvalid: Choose a permission mode: read-only or ask before changes.
agents.visibilityInvalid: Choose who can use the agent: only the owner or the whole workspace.
agents.stateInvalid: The status must be Enabled, Disabled or Archived.
agents.textInvalid: Text fields cannot contain null characters; remove them and try again.
agents.hostNotFound: The pinned host no longer exists or is not a Runner host; unpin it on the agent page.
agents.ownerNotMember: The owner must be an active member of this workspace; choose another owner.
agents.ownerInactive: The owner's account is disabled; choose another owner.
agents.upstreamAuthenticationFailed: The model service rejected the API key (401). Check the credential linked to this model service, then retry.
